title: Learn how the Port Street Vendor lottery works

paragraphs: You can apply for the monthly lottery after you have been approved as a vendor on Port property.
Certain Port locations are only available to venders via a monthly lottery. Learn about how the lottery works.

sections.heading: Who can enter the lottery
paragraphs: Vendors that have submitted all documents required to vend at the Port will receive a link to enter the lottery each month.

sections.heading: How we conduct the lottery
paragraphs: Public Works staff will perform the lottery drawings for each location in the following order:
From the location with the greatest number of entries
To the location with the least number of entries

sections.heading: After we conduct the lottery
paragraphs: After the lottery drawing, we will notify you of the results and let you know if you were selected.
You may vend at the location indicated in the lottery results.

Please note: To vend at these locations, the vendor must be the selected winner for that specific day. If the selected vendor does not appear, the spot will not be reassigned or made available to other vendors.
You may enter future lotteries for another chance to vend at your selected location.
